_comment: Tailscale Serve is the ONLY ingress to the orchestrator - for supervisors as well as for the operator.
The process binds 127.0.0.1 and nothing else, so nothing is on a public interface and the operator
routes are unreachable from the tailnet rather than merely refused.
Serve strips any client-supplied Tailscale-User-* header and injects its own. That is the whole basis
on which requireOperator trusts the identity, and it is only sound because the listener cannot be
reached any other way. Verify it before relying on it - infra/verify.sh does.
Funnel is never enabled here. Funnel traffic is public and carries no identity headers at all,
so it would arrive at a loopback listener as an unauthenticated request from Serve.
